introHtml: Heart-shaped badge ID holders add a distinctive touch to your company's branding, making them ideal for events focused on wellness, charity, or team spirit. Unlike standard rectangular holders, the heart shape softens the professional look while still securely displaying ID cards. Available in clear vinyl or nylon, these holders can be paired with lanyards or clips for easy wear. Perfect for HR teams or marketing directors looking to show appreciation or create a memorable impression at conferences.
